Speech.NativeText: }:-| I can't stick around in this crew while %1 is on it. {:-( It's time to cut and run.
Where did %1 go?
Hmm, I might have an idea. %1 mentioned a back-up plan, some old jalopy %2 knew how to get working. The idea was to take that and hit the road, if ever things got too hot round here.
%1 could be a good person to ask... %2 was the one who got on best with %3.
{:-| No idea, sorry! Wish I could help, %1 was a good %2.

}:-| I guess after the altercation with %1, %2 decided %3'd had enough. :-| The vehicle is out round %4 way. {:-| But if you plan to go looking for %5, I suggest get %6 to go make peace. No way you'll get %7 to come back otherwise.
I don't know. Never knew %1 that well.
Don't know, don't care. We're better off without %1!
%1, won't you come back home?
}:-| I got nothing to say to you!
}:-| Not while %1 is still around.
%1 has left %2.
%1 is dead.
}:-| Makes no difference to me. How do I know you won't take %1 back?
/:-| Seriously, %1 had %2 killed for my sake?
}:-) Yeah. %1 did you wrong and %2 took action! So, how about it?
No, it was an accident. Are you coming back or what?
}:-) Alright then, justice has been served. The system works!
I suppose I might as well if I don't have to worry about %1 anymore. Thanks for coming to get me.
{:-| %1 wasn't a good place for me.
{:-| Look, I'm sorry, okay? Things got out of hand.
}:-| Suit yourself.
}:-| I ain't coming back, alright? If you're really sorry then just help me get the fuck out of here. {:-| I got this thing all fixed up, except it's missing a part and I can't find it anywhere.
Fine, I'll help. What's the missing part?
}:-[ Get your ass back here or I'll beat you a second time, only more so.
{:-[ Just do whatever you want with me, I don't care anymore.
}:-| Follow me, you little bitch.
:-) In your dreams.
}:-| You jumped ship - you're on your own with that.
{:-| The driver's side phalange. It's a very specific part. The engine will explode without it.
You might be in luck. Before I joined this crew, I had a little stash of useful supplies, including a few car parts, hidden in %1. I'm pretty sure there was a phalange in there, maybe it'll fit!
/:-| Really? Hell, let's go get it then.
My stash is near here, in the %1. I'll show you where.
It was around here. In a %1. {:-| I hope it's still there. I mean, I thought I hid it pretty well. It should still be there.
My stash is in the %1. }:-| Unless some bastard has found it already.
I'm at the stash, %1, are you coming or what?
My stash is near here. {:-| I thought we were going to do this together, %1?
So I hid my stuff in the %1 here, got some valuable components which I could have used... }:-| You better appreciate this!
You're near the stash, %1, but you'll need me to find it for you.
}:-| Uh, %1, you're not going to be able to find the stash without me there. I thought that would be obvious but apparently I have to explain everything.
This looks like it would fit! {:-) You actually came through for me, %1.
:-( Hmm, it's off-brand but I guess we can give it a try. Not like I got a lot of options here.
It's a slightly different model but we can give it a try. :-) Let's hope it doesn't make the whole thing blow up or something!
Uh... that's a pretty lucky coincidence. Is this some trick? Why do you want to help me now?
{:-| It's no trick, I swear. Just good luck. If it even fits, that is.
/:-) Really? Maybe you're not all bad.
You might be in luck, we've already got one of those. Seems they're in demand lately.
:-) We did it? It's working!
/:-| Holy shit. Can't believe we actually got that old thing working.
}:-) Fuck yeah! It's working! Nothing can stop us! Go team!
Well %1, I guess this is it then, I'm outta here. I know we haven't always gotten along but I just want you to know that... we're good now.
Well, I guess this is goodbye, %1. I know we haven't exactly gotten along in the past but I just want you to know that I now think of you as a... casual aquaintance.
{:-) Well %1, I guess this is the end of the road. I just want you to know that whatever happened between us is water under the bridge. I will always remember that you helped me in the end!
}:-| Well, guess I'll fuck off now. Have a nice life %1.
Here's the phalange. What do you think?
That oughtta do it.
{:-) You know what? I could give %1 another chance. I'll come back with you.
/:-| You're obviously not as scary as you think you are.
:-) Yeah? Well I for one am glad to have you back. We needed you.
}:-| Ah who am I kidding, I'd probably manage to get eaten by zombies before I even left the county. Better to die horribly with friends than alone. {:-| Take me back, I want to come home!
Then again, the probability of me surviving out there by myself has got to be... oh, at least a little bit lower than with a group. I'd like to reconsider.
}:-| Took you long enough to realise it! Still, I always figured you'd come crawling back eventually.
{:-) I'm so glad you've changed your mind. The place just wouldn't be the same without you!
8-( Holy shit! Did you see that? Whole thing just exploded! I could have died!
8-| Jesus. I got out just in time.
}:-| Shit. Must have been that aftermarket phalange.
8-( Oh my god. %1! No! Noooo!
}:-| Dammit, must have been the wrong type of phalange.
So this is where you've been hiding!
}:-| I'm not interested in a reunion, okay? I just want out of here.
}:-| I guess after your altercation, %1 decided %2'd had enough. :-| The vehicle is out round %3 way. {:-| If you want %4 back I suggest you go yourself to make peace.
{:-| I guess after our altercation, %1 decided %2'd had enough. :-| The vehicle is out round %3 way. I probably better go myself to make peace.
{:-( Shit, there goes my best chance of getting out of here. Just gonna have to wing it.

Quest.NativeDescription: %1 has abandoned you! Ask around your group to try and discover where %2 went.
Get %1 to %2 old vehicle so %3 can make peace.
Get %1 to show %2 the phalange in %3 hidden stash.
Take %1 back to the %2 so %3 can repair it.
